asia.name: Asia
asia.intro: From warming cups of chai to colourful rice bowls, discover a few favourites from across Asia.
drinks: Black tea, milk, water, ginger, cardamom, sugar
Simmer ginger and cardamom in water. Add tea, then milk and sugar; bring to a gentle simmer and strain.
Whisk sifted matcha with a little warm water until smooth. Top with warmed, frothed milk.
Ripe mango, plain yogurt, milk, cardamom
Blend mango and yogurt with a splash of milk. Add cardamom and serve chilled.
breakies: Flattened rice, onion, mustard seeds, turmeric, peanuts, lemon
Rinse flattened rice briefly. Temper mustard seeds, cook onion and peanuts, then gently fold in rice and turmeric. Finish with lemon.
Fermented rice-and-urad-dal batter, water, oil for greasing
Grease idli moulds, fill with prepared fermented batter, and steam until set. Serve with coconut chutney or sambar.
Beat eggs with soy sauce and a little sugar. Cook thin layers in an oiled pan, rolling each layer into the next; cook through and slice.
fullies: Chana Masala
India
Cooked chickpeas, onion, tomato, ginger, garlic, cumin, garam masala
Cook onion, ginger and garlic with spices. Add tomatoes, then cooked chickpeas and water; simmer until the sauce thickens.
Vegetable Sushi Rolls
Japan-inspired
Sushi rice, nori, rice vinegar, cucumber, carrot, avocado
Season cooked sushi rice with rice vinegar. Spread on nori, add sliced vegetables, roll tightly and cut into pieces.
Chicken Biryani
South Asia
Chicken, basmati rice, yogurt, onion, ginger, garlic, biryani spices
Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices. Cook the chicken, layer with partially cooked rice and browned onions, and steam covered until chicken and rice are fully cooked.

europe.name: Europe
europe.intro: Explore café drinks, comforting breakfasts and familiar meals from European kitchens.
drinks: Use an espresso machine to extract a small, concentrated coffee from finely ground beans. Serve immediately.
Warm milk with chopped chocolate. Whisk in a small cornflour slurry and simmer gently until thick and smooth.
Dissolve sugar in warm water and cool. Mix with lemon juice, freeze in a shallow tray, and scrape regularly with a fork.
breakies: Rolled oats, water or milk, salt, fruit
Simmer oats with water or milk and a pinch of salt, stirring until creamy. Top with fruit.
Bread, ripe tomato, olive oil, garlic, salt
Toast bread and rub lightly with garlic. Spoon over grated tomato and finish with olive oil and salt.
Toast the bread. Stir beaten eggs gently in melted butter over low heat until cooked; serve on toast.
fullies: Pasta al Pomodoro
Italy
Pasta without egg, tomato, garlic, basil, olive oil
Simmer garlic and tomatoes in olive oil. Toss with cooked pasta and a little pasta water; finish with basil.
Ratatouille
France
Aubergine, courgette, pepper, tomato, onion, olive oil
Chop the vegetables. Sauté onion in olive oil, add remaining vegetables and simmer gently until tender.
Fish and Chips
United Kingdom
White fish, potato, flour, sparkling water, oil
Cut and cook potato chips. Coat fish in a flour-and-sparkling-water batter, then fry carefully until crisp and cooked through.

africa.name: Africa
africa.intro: Meet fragrant teas, hearty grains and warming stews from a few of Africa’s many food traditions.
drinks: Green tea, fresh mint, water, sugar
Steep green tea in hot water, add fresh mint and sugar to taste, and pour into small glasses.
Dried hibiscus petals, water, sugar, mint
Simmer food-grade hibiscus petals in water, strain, and sweeten to taste. Cool and serve over ice with mint.
Steep rooibos in freshly boiled water, strain and serve plain or with milk.
breakies: Cooked fava beans, lemon, garlic, cumin, olive oil
Warm cooked fava beans with a little water. Mash lightly and season with garlic, cumin, lemon and olive oil.
Millet or sorghum flour, water, milk or sugar if desired
Mix flour with cold water to form a slurry. Stir into simmering water and cook, stirring, until smooth and fully cooked.
Flour, coconut milk, sugar, baking powder, cardamom, oil
Mix an egg-free dough with the flour, coconut milk, sugar, baking powder and cardamom. Rest, roll, cut and fry carefully until cooked and golden.
fullies: Vegetable Couscous
North Africa
Couscous, vegetable stock, carrot, courgette, chickpeas, spices
Cook vegetables and chickpeas in spiced vegetable stock. Prepare couscous separately according to its packet and serve with the vegetables.
Vegetable Jollof Rice
West Africa
Rice, tomato, red pepper, onion, vegetable stock, thyme
Blend tomatoes, peppers and onion. Cook the mixture down, add washed rice and vegetable stock, then cover and cook until tender.
Doro Wat
Ethiopia
Chicken, onion, berbere spice, butter, garlic, ginger
Slowly cook chopped onion, then add butter, ginger, garlic and berbere. Add chicken and water and simmer until the chicken is fully cooked.

americas.name: Americas
americas.intro: Travel from bright fruit drinks to corn-based breakfasts and comforting bean bowls.
drinks: Steep food-grade hibiscus petals in hot water, strain and sweeten. Dilute to taste and serve chilled.
Stir fresh lime juice with water and sugar until dissolved. Adjust to taste and serve over ice.
Mix cocoa and sugar with a splash of milk to form a paste. Whisk in remaining milk, warm gently and add vanilla.
breakies: Precooked maize flour, water, salt, oil, optional cheese
Mix precooked maize flour with water and salt. Shape into discs and cook on a lightly oiled griddle until cooked through; add filling.
Cooked rice, cooked black beans, onion, pepper, coriander
Sauté onion and pepper. Add cooked beans and rice, stir until hot, and finish with chopped coriander.
Tortilla, eggs, cooked beans, potato, salsa
Cook diced potato until tender and scramble the eggs until cooked. Wrap with hot beans and salsa in a warm tortilla.
fullies: Vegetarian Tacos
Mexico-inspired
Corn tortillas, cooked beans, cabbage, tomato, avocado, lime
Warm tortillas and beans. Fill with beans, shredded cabbage, tomato and avocado, then squeeze lime over the top.
Vegetarian Chili
United States
Kidney beans, tomato, onion, pepper, cumin, chili powder
Sauté onion and pepper with spices. Add tomatoes and cooked beans, then simmer until rich and thick.
Beef Empanadas
Argentina
Egg-free pastry, minced beef, onion, paprika, olives
Cook beef and onion with paprika, drain and cool. Fill pastry rounds, add olives, seal and bake until pastry is golden and filling is hot.

middle-east.name: Middle East
middle-east.intro: Discover cardamom-scented coffee, fresh breads and meals built around herbs and pulses.
drinks: Simmer coffee in water, add cardamom and allow grounds to settle. Pour gently into small cups.
Whisk yogurt with cold water and a pinch of salt until frothy. Serve chilled.
Lemon juice, mint, water, sugar, ice
Blend lemon juice, fresh mint, water, sugar and ice. Adjust sweetness and serve immediately.
breakies: Shape dough into small flatbreads. Mix zaatar with olive oil, spread over the dough and bake until cooked and lightly golden.
Labneh, cucumber, tomato, olive oil, pita
Spread labneh on a plate, drizzle with olive oil and serve with sliced vegetables and pita bread.
Simmer onion, pepper and tomato with cumin. Make wells, crack in eggs and cover until eggs are cooked.
fullies: Mujadara
Levant
Lentils, rice, onion, olive oil, cumin
Brown sliced onions slowly. Cook lentils and rice with cumin until tender and serve topped with the browned onions.
Falafel Wrap
Middle East
Prepared falafel, pita, tomato, cucumber, tahini, lemon
Warm fully cooked falafel and pita. Fill with sliced vegetables and drizzle with tahini mixed with lemon and water.
Chicken Shawarma Bowl
Middle East
Chicken, yogurt, shawarma spices, rice, salad
Marinate chicken in yogurt and spices, then cook thoroughly and slice. Serve over cooked rice with salad.

oceania.name: Oceania
oceania.intro: Explore familiar café breakfasts, island flavours and a few Australian and New Zealand favourites.
drinks: Prepare espresso and top with steamed milk with a thin layer of fine foam.
Scoop feijoa pulp and blend with banana, yogurt and a splash of milk until smooth.
Pacific Islands and other tropical regions
Fresh or packaged coconut water, optional lime
Serve coconut water chilled. Add a squeeze of lime if desired.
breakies: Toast bread, mash avocado with lemon and seasoning, then spread over the toast.
Place cereal biscuits in a bowl, add milk and top with sliced banana or berries.
Australia and New Zealand café food
Toast and butter sourdough. Cook eggs to your preference until cooked and serve over the toast.
fullies: Kumara Soup
New Zealand-inspired
Kumara (sweet potato), onion, vegetable stock, coconut milk
Sauté onion, add chopped kumara and vegetable stock, and simmer until soft. Blend and stir in coconut milk.
Vegetable Barbecue
Australia-inspired
Courgette, pepper, corn, mushroom, olive oil, herbs
Cut vegetables into suitable pieces, coat with oil and herbs, and grill, turning, until tender.
Meat Pie
Australia and New Zealand
Pastry, minced beef, onion, flour, beef stock
Cook beef and onion, stir in flour and stock and simmer until thick. Cool, enclose in pastry and bake until golden and thoroughly heated.
